note: Per-cell element ledger derived from HGSS land_data. lab: T rock top, E/S/W/N rock face by downhill direction, L jump south, Q jump west, J blocked ledge corner, F tree, X other blocked (buildings, props), . open. floor: ground under the cell. ground: HGSS ground height (terrace level = ground - 4; rock cells use peak - 4). trees: HGSS 2x2 tree footprints, top-left cell.
